meta.description: EMUPERSO: NES, SNES, Sega Genesis, Game Boy, Game Boy Color, Game Boy Advance, Nintendo DS, Nintendo 64, PlayStation and PlayStation Portable in Chrome, on desktop and phone.
header.subtitle: Retro portal · 13 systems
header.intro: Play in Chrome on desktop or phone, no app to install and no account. Each console offers a free demo to try right away; your own games stay on your device.
consoles.title: Choose a console
card.nes.desc: FCEUmm engine. Free demo: Snake. Game Genie codes, saves and states.
card.snes.desc: Snes9x engine. Free demos: Neon Breaker, Shmup, SA-1 and DSP-1 chips. Game Genie and Action Replay.
card.nds.desc: DeSmuME engine (or melonDS with your BIOS). Free demo: Pong.
card.genesis.desc: Genesis Plus GX engine. Your .md, .smd, .gen, .bin, ZIP or 7z games, with a version picker. Cheats loaded per game, saves and states. 32X not supported.
card.n64.desc: Mupen64Plus-Next engine. Free EMUPERSO demo. Real games being validated.
card.ps1.desc: PCSX ReARMed engine. Free EMUPERSO demo. Real games being validated.
card.psp.desc: PPSSPP engine. Your .iso, .cso or .pbp games. Per-game CWCheat codes, memory card saves and states. Desktop recommended.
card.gamecube.desc: Gecko engine (WebAssembly/WebGPU, no audio). ALPHA: boots proven, playability not validated. WebGPU required. Your .iso, .gcm, .rvz, .dol images.
card.arcade.desc: MAME 2003-Plus and FBNeo engines, picked automatically for each game. Your .zip romsets (MAME short names). Per-game cheats in the MAME menu. No BIOS provided.
card.doom.desc: PrBoom engine. Your GOG DOOM games as .wad: DOOM, DOOM II, Final DOOM (Plutonia, TNT). Gamepad and touch controls. No game provided.
notes.title: Good to know
note.home.title: Your games stay with you
note.home.text: The site can't read your drive: you pick a file or folder yourself. Nothing is sent to a server; the game runs in your browser. No commercial game or BIOS provided.
note.saves.title: Separate saves
note.saves.text: Each game has its own space, identified by its file fingerprint. The browser may wipe this data (cleanup, low space): export your saves regularly.
note.android.title: Android phone
note.android.text: Touch buttons appear under the picture. Sound starts after a first tap. A Bluetooth controller recognized by Chrome works too.
apk.title: Android app (test)
apk.text: EMUPERSO as an app: it opens this same site full screen, without the Chrome bar. Android 7 or later, up-to-date Chrome. Test version: installation still to be confirmed on your phone.
apk.step1: Download the file from your Android phone.
apk.step2: Open it. If Android asks, allow installing from the app that opens it, just this once.
apk.step3: Install, then remove that permission. No games or BIOS are included: your games stay on your device.

contact.title: Contact — report a bug
contact.intro: A bug, a crash, weird behavior on a console? Write to Karl — reports are used to fix EMUPERSO.

contact.template.title: Bug report template
contact.template.hint: Copy this template into your email and fill in every line:
contact.template.text:
Console / system:
Game (name + region if known):
What happened:
Steps to reproduce:

Browser / device:

contact.rules.title: Rules
contact.rule1: This page is static: nothing is sent or stored by EMUPERSO — your email goes straight from your mail app.
contact.rule2: Never send ROMs, BIOS files or saves by email: everyone brings their own files (BYOR), they stay on your device.
